title: Spatially resolved dust properties over 50 kpc in a hyperluminous galaxy merger at z = 4.6
question: What are the spatially resolved dust properties (mass, emissivity index, emitting area, temperature) across the ~50 kpc W2246-0526 hot DOG merger system, and what heats the dust in the hot DOG, streams and companions?

data.angular_resolution: Native beams 0.54x0.46 to 0.35x0.30 arcsec (without uv-taper); homogenised to a common circular 1.0 arcsec beam
data.sensitivity: Continuum rms of collapsed datasets from 0.007 to 1.36 mJy/beam (Table 1)

what.value: Dust opacity kappa_850um = 0.0968 kg^-1 m^2 at nu_0 = 352.7 GHz, following Scoville et al. 2014

evidence.quote: Following (cite: scoville2014) and assuming a gas-to-dust ratio of
we adopt $\kappa_0=\kappa_{850\upmu\mathrm{m}}=0.0968\ \mathrm{kg}^{-1} \mathrm{m}^2$ and $\nu_0 = 352.7$ GHz (850$\upmu\mathrm{m}$)

what.value: Hot DOG metallicity ~0.5 Zsun, used to justify gas-to-dust ratio 200

evidence.quote: given that the metallicity in the hot DOG is $\sim0.5$ Z$_{\odot}$ (cite: fernandez2024)

recipe.method: Reduce and calibrate each dataset with CASA using standard data reduction procedures

recipe.goal: image the continuum at a common 1.0 arcsec resolution
recipe.method: tclean continuum imaging of line-free channels with Hogbom cleaning, Briggs weighting and a uv-taper, restored to a common circular beam
key_parameters: uv-taper 0.8 arcsec; restoring beam circular FWHM 1.0 arcsec
clean threshold 2 x rms of each cube; circular mask radius 7 arcsec

recipe.goal: fit a modified blackbody to the integrated central beam (hot DOG) with all eight datasets
recipe.method: Fit the modified blackbody of Eq. 1 (area A, T_d, M_d, beta free; CMB contrast term included) to the eight central-beam fluxes
assumptions: Gas-to-dust ratio 200 (hot DOG metallicity ~0.5 Zsun); kappa_850um = 0.0968 kg^-1 m^2 at 352.7 GHz
Flat LCDM, H0 = 70 km/s/Mpc, Omega_M = 0.3; lower T limit set by T_CMB at z=4.601

recipe.goal: derive resolved dust parameter maps pixel by pixel
recipe.method: Fit the same modified blackbody to every pixel with emission in the four datasets with extended detections (rest-frame 149 to 357 um)
key_parameters: Same flat priors on A, T_d, M_d, beta as the central-beam fit
Upper limit on A set by the beam area
assumptions: Same gas-to-dust ratio (200), kappa_850um and cosmology as step 3

recipe.goal: derive optical depth, IR luminosity, SFR surface density and star formation efficiency maps
recipe.method: tau at rest-frame 158 um from Eq. 3; L_3-1100um by integrating each pixel's modified blackbody; SFR from L_IR; Sigma_SFR = SFR/A; SFE = SFR/M_gas
key_parameters: Sigma_SFR = SFR/A with A the intrinsic emitting area from the fit
assumptions: SFR from L_IR following Kennicutt & Evans 2012; M_gas = M_d x gas-to-dust ratio 200

recipe.goal: estimate the SFR of the extended component and compare with theory
recipe.method: Integrate the luminosity outside the central 2 arcsec region to get the extended SFR; compare central L_IR and Sigma_SFR with the Eddington limit for starbursts and with quasar heating predictions
